title: Regulatory Affairs Intern
description:
Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is interested in how government policy and regulation impact critical infrastructure, utility services, and customer outcomes. They possess strong analytical skills, enjoy researching complex issues, and are eager to learn about the intersection of public policy, business strategy, and utility operations.

**This is a 12-week summer internship program starting in May 2027, for students entering their junior or senior year in fall 2027. The role is based in Chester, Virginia. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the reporting location to be eligible.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

- Monitor and summarize activities of the Virginia State Corporation Commission (SCC), Virginia General Assembly, and relevant federal regulatory agencies.

- Conduct research on regulatory, legislative, and policy issues affecting utility operations and customer programs.

- Assist in the preparation and organization of regulatory filings, reports, and supporting documentation.

- Support regulatory proceedings by gathering data, tracking case activity, and summarizing Commission orders and regulatory developments.

- Analyze proposed legislation, regulations, and policy changes and prepare impact summaries for internal stakeholders.

- Assist with compliance tracking and regulatory reporting requirements.

- Prepare presentations, reports, briefing materials, and executive summaries.

- Maintain regulatory records, filing systems, and data repositories.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect information and support regulatory initiatives.

- Participate in special projects involving utility regulation, customer programs, broadband deployment, renewable energy policy, infrastructure investment, and economic development initiatives.

Learning Opportunities

The selected intern will gain exposure to:

- Virginia State Corporation Commission proceedings and processes

- Utility regulatory strategy and compliance

- Legislative and policy analysis

- Utility rate and tariff concepts

- Broadband, telecommunications, and energy policy issues

- Regulatory research and stakeholder communications

- Cross-functional utility operations and business decision-making

Qualifications

Required

- Must be a rising junior or senior- c urrently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in:

- Public Policy

- Political Science

- Economics

- Business Administration

- Finance

- Public Administration

- Communications

- Law/pre-Law

- Engineering

- Related field

- Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

- Strong analytical and research abilities.

- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

- Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.

Preferred

- Interest in utility regulation, energy policy, broadband policy, telecommunications, government affairs, or public administration.

- Familiarity with the Virginia legislative process or regulatory environment.

- Experience researching public policy or regulatory issues.

- Knowledge of data analysis and reporting tools such as Power BI.

- Previous in

- Internship or leadership experience demonstrating initiative and problem-solving skills.

Desired Competencies

- Intellectual curiosity

- Professionalism

- Critical thinking

- Research and analysis

- Written communication

- Attention to detail

- Collaboration and teamwork

- Initiative and adaptability

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
Lead Data Scientist
Full Time Perm
Shift: Hybrid - 3 days on location
Salary:   $133,400 - $200,100, plus 10% annual bonus
Location: Columbus, OH

NiSource is one of the largest fully regulated utility companies in the U.S., serving millions of customers across six states. We’re more than an energy provider—we’re a team committed to innovation, inclusion, and growth. At NiSource, you’ll find a workplace that encourages collaboration, supports professional development, and empowers employees to make an impact.

The Data Science organization at NiSource is the recently established advanced analytics arm of the company. We are building a talented team that is leveraging best-in-class tools and techniques to solve our company's highest value analytics use cases. With a strong team culture and commitment to innovative problem solving, the solutions that we build will be a competitive advantage for our company for many years to come.

The Lead Data Scientist will report up through the Enterprise Data & Analytics Organization and function as a technical consultant in data science organization in order to:

- Serve as an expert in translating complex data into key strategy insights and valuable actions

- Discover insights from data and present them to other data scientists, business stakeholders, and leaders at various levels

- Perform data exploration and data mining

- Build impactful modeling solutions with AI and Machine Learning techniques

Your additional responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

- Develops advanced ML, AI and statistical models that create value for the organization

- Leads recommendations from ideation to delivery of solution

- Coaches, reviews and delegates work to professionals with less experience

- Works independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations

- Communicate effectively to senior leadership without oversight

- Influences others regarding policies, practices and procedures

- Collaborates with Business Clients, establish professional relationships in order to understand business needs

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree

- 7+ years of experience as a data scientist, data analyst, or similar role

- 7+ years of experience coding in statistical and database languages (SQL, Python, R, Spark, etc)

- 7+ years of experience using machine learning such as NLP, image recognition, boosted trees, or related duties

- Strong knowledge of cloud platform tools and techniques

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's Degree or advanced degree in statistics, data science, physics, mathematics, engineering, computer science, or comparable discipline

title: Natural Resources Permitting Coordinator
description:
Job Summary
A corporate-wide position involving professional technical skill and/or judgment in areas involving an integration of science, legal requirements, operational activities and policy. The Environmental Coordinator is responsible for analysis, design, implementation and management of existing and new environmental programs, regulations and legislation to provide environmental support for business units in a proactive, cost-effective manner that is consistent with NiSource policy and business objectives. Responsibilities encompass a wide-range of environmental program areas with a primary focus on natural resources in accordance with local, state and federal requirements.

Essential Functions

- Preparation and coordination of environmental permitting for a variety of project and programs supporting NiSource and Columbia Gas of Pennsylvania.

- Coordinates and/or performs required environmental activities necessary to ensure environmental programs and permits are properly implemented and attain 100% compliance, including field investigations to verify conformance with engineering and construction plans.

- Coordinates with affected business partners to align business operational needs and constraints with efficient and effective environmental risk minimization and mitigation.

- Maintains a working knowledge of current environmental regulations and the regulatory process.

- Analyzes and interprets environmental related rules, regulations, policies and guidelines as necessary to meet applicable requirements and/or corporate directives.

- Oversee environmental resource surveys, environmental report and/or assessment preparation, and other environmental permitting.

- Partner with construction field personnel to achieve compliance goals and meet regulatory requirements. Engage in problem solving dialogue and provide recommendations for improvement and compliance.

- Participate in and/or lead meetings, training sessions, and calls with internal stakeholders and external partners including contractors, agencies, and associations.

- Supports and implements compliance and proactive environmental systems and programs.

- Utilizes existing systems, processes and procedures to identify and communicate opportunities for environmental related continuous improvement.

- Integrate business and regulatory needs and coordinate with multiple levels and multiple business partners within the organization to utilize change management tools and skills to facilitate action planning.

- Provides clear, concise and effective communication with business partners to keep stakeholder informed of project status.

- Be a self-starter with a high degree of initiative and ability to work both independently and within a team.

- Promotes and assures safe working environment and public safety.

Required Qualifications For Position

- Bachelor's Degree in Science, Environmental Science, or related field. Equivalent work experience may be substituted.

- A minimum of 3 – 5 years relevant experience is required for this position.

- Working knowledge of natural resources permitting requirements (e.g., wetland and waterbody crossings, earth disturbance, threatened and endangered species) in the state of Pennsylvania with a specific focus on environmental regulations related to the energy industry.

- Knowledge of energy industry operations.

- Strong learning agility skills and ability to adapt to a consistently changing environment.

- Self-directed aptitude and willing to contribute in a wide array of environmental disciplines.

- Ability to work cooperatively and build consensus within a diverse working group.

- Ability to use professional judgment and work in a self-directed manner with an appropriate level of direct supervision.

- Well-developed analytical and communication skills.

- Competent in the use of electronic spreadsheets and word processing software.

- Knowledge of work management support systems (e.g. SAP S/4 HANA, GIS, Smartsheet).

- Well-developed analytical and communication skills.

- Experience directing third party consultants.

- Understanding of basic principles of project management.

- Approximately 5 - 25% travel.

The preceding description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities required of the position.

title: Lead IT Business Analyst
description:
Lead IT Business Analyst
Full Time Perm
Way of Work : Hybrid - 3 days on location Tu/Wed/Thurs
Salary: $113,500 - $170,300, plus 10% annual bonus
Location : Columbus, OH

NiSource is one of the largest fully regulated utility companies in the U.S., serving millions of customers across six states. We’re more than an energy provider—we’re a team committed to innovation, inclusion, and growth. At NiSource, you’ll find a workplace that encourages collaboration, supports professional development, and empowers employees to make an impact.

Customer Transformation team supports NiSource’s multi-year effort to modernize customer experience through changes to process, technology, and ways of working. This role partners with business leaders, SMEs, IT, and vendors to define future-state processes, validate requirements, and streamline workflows.

The Lead IT Analyst is responsible for identifying, defining and documenting business requirements and functional specifications for Customer Information Systems Transformation project and initiatives by collaborating with service providers, business partners, and stakeholders to ensure alignment of expectations, deliverables, and timelines.

As a Lead IT Analyst, you will act as a liaison between the business, IT, and other project stakeholders. This role will be primarily assigned to the customer transformation team where they will help maintain a subset of applications, execution of application projects, assist with requirements gathering and coordination within an agile or waterfall team.

Your responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

- Review and approve business requirements, functional specifications, and process documentation.

- Ensure consistency and quality across all BA deliverables.

- Manage requirements throughout the project lifecycle.

- Maintain Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and ensure traceability from requirements through testing and deployment.

- Review solution designs for alignment with business objectives.

- Oversee RICEFW and workstream deliverables including Functional Designs (FD), Technical Designs (TD), Functional Unit Testing (FUT), and related project artifacts.

- Track status, dependencies, risks, and issues across assigned workstreams.

- Coordinate business validation and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

- Ensure requirements are adequately tested, and defects are resolved.

- Participate in defect triage and production readiness reviews.

- Work with PM to maintain RAID logs and drive issue resolution activities.

- Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.

- Escalate critical issues when necessary and facilitate resolution.

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

- 8+ years of progressive IT Business Analysis experience

- 3+ years of experience leading Business Analysts and/or complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives

- Demonstrated experience supporting large-scale business and technology transformation programs

- Advanced skills in requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, stakeholder facilitation, and translating business needs into actionable requirements

- Experience working across Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies

- Proficiency with JIRA, Qtest, Tricentis Tosca, or comparable project and work management tools

Preferred Qualifications

- Utility industry experience.

- Customer Information System (CIS) implementation experience.

- SAP IS-U, SAP S/4HANA, or similar enterprise platform experience.

- CBAP, PMI-PBA, Agile BA, or equivalent certification.

- Experience managing third-party vendors and system integrators.

Disclaimer

title: Intern IT - Software Engineer
location_raw: Merrillville IN-SLC; Columbus OH - Arena District
description:
NiSource Internship Program Introduction
NiSource is currently seeking a Summer IT - Software Engineer Intern. Successful applicants will become integral members of the department while learning within a team environment, completing meaningful tasks and collaborating with team members and leaders on important projects. This position will be a great opportunity for the candidate desiring to launch their career in this field. Successful applicants will build professional relationships with other interns and all levels of NiSource personnel while participating in rewarding professional development exercises and fun, team-building activities. Interns will obtain a broad overview of NiSource's operations and current events in the utilities industry.

This is a 12-week summer internship program starting in May 2027, for students entering their junior or senior year in fall 2027. The role is based in Columbus, OH or Merrillville, IN. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the reporting location to be eligible.

Essential Functions

- Enterprise Architecture
• Enterprise Architecture is responsible for creating the technology strategy and roadmap. This team is responsible for developing standards and guidelines that should be used in planning, designing and implementing Information Technology applications and platforms. This team works collaboratively with other groups to drive the architecture vision for NiSource.

- IT Services
• The Services supports the delivery of IT Application and Infrastructure services, including hardware and software asset and configuration management, for all NiSource business units. This role works with the Manager of IT Service Integration, Manager of IT Service Governance and other Technology Tower Leads to ensure that Infrastructure and Application Services are fully integrated and delivered within the scope of Service Provider Contracts as reflected by service levels, statements of work and pertinent schedules/exhibits.

- Infrastructure
• Infrastructure, network delivery, primary responsibility is to provide network technical design leadership and to oversee execution of processes associated incident, problem, change, asset, and configuration management within this technology domain. This includes working with enterprise architects, program managers, IT analysts and managed service providers to effectively manage infrastructure operations and support delivery of Infrastructure projects. It also includes development and periodic review of ITIL based processes and practices to ensure highly available operations and compliance with architecture standards and strategies.

- IT Security
• The IT Security organization is responsible for the resolution of IT Security incidents; manages preparation & planning for future IT security threats, and follows security trends, threats and vulnerabilities. This role will work on a project to develop and execute a specific cyber incident response scenario exercise and develop a broad-view perspective of the cybersecurity space. Incident response improvement with better Integration of security and IT Operations processes. Work across towers to understand the interrelationships between IT Operations processes, and our company as a whole.

- IT Applications

- The IT Applications Developer Job Family encompasses job responsibilities and accountability for various IT applications development, system administration, and support functions necessary to ensure a stable and reliable application environment for NiSource. The application environment encompasses mission critical information systems such as Gas distribution, Hydro and Electrical Grid control systems, Electronic Measurement and other business critical applications. The job also includes the analysis and development of business applications, system interfaces, and other duties related to application system development lifecycle.

- Business Analytics

• The Business Analytics Intern will leverage their skillset in areas such as data discovery, modeling and visualizing results to identify and discover patterns throughout the business. Through collaboration with business units, this professional will be capable of acquiring, cleansing and structuring data from multiple sources to deliver key analytics based insight to drive business decisions.

Required Qualifications For Position

- Acquiring a degree in data science, computer science, computer engineering, statistics, mathematics

- GPA of 3.0 or higher

- Have completed at least one year of undergraduate study

- Experience with cloud, software development, data analytics, automation, or enterprise technologies

- Keen attention to detail and a quality focused mindset

- Strong oral and written communication skills

- Self-discipline for planning and organizing tasks

- Passionate about data

- History of being able to learn new technology quickly

- Solid skills in utilizing computers, operating systems, mobile devices and software (MS Office Suite, MS Project, and other IT applications).

- Excellent analytical abilities, including process analysis and development, problem-solving and root-cause analysis.

- Ability to work 40 hours per week

- Authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship
